title: Christmas on Duty
overview: Longtime rivals who trained together at the Basic School in Quantico are forced to work together once again after years of not speaking, and when a snowstorm prevents all the Christmas presents from being delivered to base, they are forced to team up for a special mission… to save Christmas.

title: A Cozy Christmas Inn
overview: Real estate exec, Erika, travels to Alaska during Christmastime to acquire a bed and breakfast, only to discover that it’s owned by her ex. While there, she finds herself falling in love with the town and quite possibly him.
